run_video_annotator_task: run the video annotator task generator script with default config and operator settings
build_video_annotator_generator: build the video annotator React app generator with optional force rebuild and post install script
configure_shared_task_state: configure shared remote procedure task state with static task data and JS function registry
launch_task_run: launch a mephisto task run using the operator with shared state and config
wait_for_runs_shutdown: wait for all task runs to complete then shutdown the operator with periodic logging
